local self = require('openmw.self')
local reported = false
local aligned=false
local frames=0
print('Tutorial passage observer loaded')
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 frames=frames+1
 local p=self.position
 if frames%15==1 then print('Tutorial player position: x=' .. tostring(p.x) .. ' y=' .. tostring(p.y) .. ' z=' .. tostring(p.z)) end
 if not aligned and p.x<=710 then aligned=true; print('Tutorial player aligned with passage: x=' .. tostring(p.x)) end
 if not reported and p.y>=280 then
  reported=true
  print('Tutorial player entered passage: x=' .. tostring(p.x) .. ' y=' .. tostring(p.y) .. ' z=' .. tostring(p.z))
 end
end}}}}
